sources.title: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B: the same answers, 37% less thinking
sources.snippet: The second model in our ThinkingCap series. We took Qwen3.8-27B and cut how much it thinks, without changing the quality of the answers.

sources.title: BottleCap AI Releases ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B: 37.2% Fewer Thinking ...
sources.snippet: BottleCap AI has released ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B, the second model in its ThinkingCap series. It is a fine-tune of the Qwen team's Qwen3.8-27B with one narrow goal: shorter reasoning traces. Across 12 benchmarks, it spends 37.2% fewer thinking tokens on average. Macro-average accuracy moves from 86.65% to 85.79%, a 0.86pp drop. Deployable? Yes. It drops in for Qwen3.8-27B on vLLM or SGLang ...
